Chambers Wildlife Rainforest Lodges
Family Owned and Operated
Welcome
Spread across 20 acres of lush, tropical Rainforest and perfectly positioned on the edge of the Lake Eacham National Park. Chambers Wildlife Rainforest Lodges offers a true Rainforest Escape, only a short drive to all of what this area has to offer.
We look forward to welcoming you with warm hospitality to this birding and rainforest paradise - only 60 minutes from Cairns.
John Chambers
S

Testimonials
What Guests Say?
This place is a fantastic little retreat in the rainforest. It’s a nature lover’s delight, with tons of lovely birds, possums, sugar gliders, platypuses, bandicoots, etc. Beautiful walks around the property, the magnificent Lake Eacham in walking distance, and all the delights of the tablelands within easy driving distance.
The units are nicely set up, comfortable and perfect for couples or families. We’ve had a fantastic time here for four nights, and would definitely come back. Thanks Chambers, it’s been unforgettable!
Dave L
Guest review
What a surprise this place was! The location was fantastic. Right in the middle of the rainforest but still very accessible. The lodge was modern, very clean and comfortable. It was also quite private given it was attached to two other rooms. The facilities were great! The pool area and games room area were an unexpected bonus and also very clean. The walking track was lovely and the nighttime viewing of the possums was amazing! We saw plenty of wildlife and had a great stay. We will definitely return!
Krjosey
Guest review
Lodge is spacious and well equipped. Staff are very welcoming and knowledgeable. Natural rainforest setting with a plethora of bird life. Rifle and cat birds enjoying the apple pieces on our verandah was so special. Sugar gliders and striped possums every night at the viewing area. Great location to explore the Atherton area. An added bonus was a complimentary load of washing, very much appreciated.
JCDreams
Guest review

pages.title: Chambers Wildlife Rainforest Lodges
pages.text:
Chambers Wildlife Rainforest Lodges
Where to find us
Location
Driving Times
Atherton: 20 mins drive
Cairns: 1 hour and 15 mins
Townsville: 4 hours drive
Flying into Cairns
We recommend hiring a car at the Cairns Airport and driving to us. This will best allow you to fully explore the natural attractions of the Waterfalls and Crater Lakes District of the Atherton Tableland as there is very limited public transport.
From Cairns, drive south to Gordonvale, then travel up the Gillies Highway onto the Atherton Tablelands. Follow the road signs to Lake Eacham. When you are looking at the waterfront at Lake Eacham, drive to the left and Chambers Wildlife Rainforest Lodges on Eacham Close is the first possible turn on the left hand side. The Lodges are a 700 metre scenic drive through the rainforest from the front gate.
FREE Onsite Parking
Private parking is available near lodges for guest cars. Parking for additional cars, busses, boats, caravans and trailers is available in the main carpark.
